announcements.title: Work From Home  - 26 September
announcements.content:
Hi everyone,

Due to the heavy rain forecast for Kanpur tomorrow, we will be working from home tomorrow, 26 September, for everyone’s safety and to avoid unnecessary travel.

Please remain available during regular working hours and continue with your planned tasks and meetings as usual.

Stay safe and take care.
